rationale: All three lenses ran (blind, edge-case, acceptance against the Jira ACs plus the plan's constraints) and the acceptance audit found every criterion met. No blocking defect survived triage: 13 raw lens items merged into 9 distinct concerns, all dismissed as accepted/documented trade-offs (--json <path> and option-value matching, --json=false, update check skipped for --json by design, stderr warning on a failed migration, doc wording, test coupling) or refuted by evidence (agent shortcut bins do not use bin/codemie.js; live runs showed 1 registry request without --json vs 0 with it, so the registryHits assertion is not vacuous; runPending always returns an object with numeric failed). No findings deferred.

business_review.item: AC1: `codemie proxy analytics status --json` on a clean CODEMIE_HOME prints only valid JSON to stdout
business_review.notes: runPending is silent for --json; update check and what's-new notice skipped; regression test asserts exit 0, JSON.parse(stdout), no 'migration(s)'. Also confirmed by live runs: before = 1819 B banner then JSON (parse fails), after = 434 B pure JSON.

business_review.item: AC2: The migration banner does not appear in stdout when --json is used
business_review.notes: All runner console.log output is gated by !silent; details go to the file log.
